notes.title: Launch of Desire: Mrs. Claus + New Patch! 🎅🔥
notes.notes:
Today’s the big day! [b]Desire: Mrs. Claus[/b] is now live on Steam, bringing fun and sensuality to this holiday season. Get ready for a challenge-packed journey with humor and charming characters. Your mission? Help 18 Mrs. Clauses around the world fulfill their unique desires and save the spirit of Christmas passion. 🎄❤️

[h3]Launch Patch[/h3]
[list]
[*] Photo Gallery: Relive your favorite moments and unlock new pictures. 📸
[*] Skip Dialogues: Focus on what matters most by skipping text.
[*] Bug Fixes: Enhanced gameplay experience with essential bug corrections.
[/list]
[h3]What to Expect from Desire: Mrs. Claus?[/h3]
[list]
[*] 18 unique, immersive levels.
[*] Clear feedback when a piece is in the correct spot. (✅)
[*] Easy-to-collect achievements.
[*] A humorous storyline with minimal text.
[*] Multiple endings to discover.
[*] A variety of Mrs. Clauses to suit all tastes.
[*] A captivating soundtrack.
[*] And a mysterious present... 🎁
[/list]

Add [b]Desire: Mrs. Claus[/b] to your library now and dive into this exciting adventure!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2743040/Desire_Mrs_Claus/
